author: Hazrat Maulana Shah Hakeem Muhammad Akhtar Saheb
title: Amal
description: Important deeds from the Quran and Hadith

items.title: The act of protection from all kinds of evil and evil of creation
items.fazilat: If you perform this wazifa for two to three minutes every morning and evening, you will surely be protected and safe from all kinds of problems and calamities, God willing. This is the best protection for protection from all kinds of harm from all evildoers. As this Wazifa is for protection from any evil and harm, there is no need to recite any Wazifa after this.
items.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah Bin Khubaib Radiyallahu Anhu

amal_text.name: You read the surah
amal_text.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
amal_text.bangla_translation: Say, He is Allah. God is impatient. He gave birth to no one and no one gave birth to Him. And there is none like Him.

amal_text.name: Surah Falak
amal_text.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
amal_text.bangla_translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of dawn — from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of the dark night, from the evil of those who blow in the glands, and from the evil of the envious when he envies.

amal_text.name: Surah Nash
amal_text.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
amal_text.bangla_translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Lord of mankind, the God of mankind — from the evil of the concealing mischief-maker, the one who insinuates evil in the hearts of mankind — from among the jinn and from among mankind.

items.title: Acts of the last three verses of Surah Hasher
items.fazilat: The person who recites Awzu Billahish-Chhami-il Alimi Minash-Shaitanir Razim three times in the morning and then recites the last three verses of Surah Hasher once, Allah appoints seventy thousand angels for him, who pray for him from morning till evening. Moreover, if he dies on that day, then he attains the death of a martyr. Similarly, if someone performs the same act in the evening, he will also be entitled to the same virtue.

amal_text.name: Ablution (3 times)
amal_text.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
amal_text.bangla_translation: I seek the refuge of Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan.

amal_text.name: The last three verses of Surah Hasher
amal_text.arabic: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
amal_text.bangla_translation: He is Allah, there is no god but He; He is the knower of the seen and unseen; He is the Most Merciful, the Most Merciful. He is Allah, there is no god but He; He is the Sovereign King, the Holy, the Peaceful, the Protector, the Protector, the Mighty, the Invincible, the Great. Glorified is Allah from what they associate. He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Shaper. He has beautiful names. Everything in the heavens and the earth proclaims His holiness. He is mighty, wise.

items.title: Hachibiyallah La-Ilaha Illa-Hu Amal (Wazifa of protection from all calamities and fulfillment of lawful desires)
items.fazilat: Whoever recites this Wazifa seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will be sufficient for all his thoughts and worries of this world and the hereafter.

amal_text.name: Hashibiallah
amal_text.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
amal_text.bangla_translation: Allah is sufficient for me; There is no god but Him. And he owns Sumhan Aresh.

items.title: The Acts of La-Hawla Wala-Quwata Illa Billah (Treasures of Heaven)
items.fazilat: La-hawla wala quwata illa billah kalamati is a priceless treasure of Paradise under Aresh. This Kalima is a medicine for ninety-nine diseases related to the world and the hereafter, among which the mildest disease is depression. Whoever recites this Kalima, Allah Almighty will address the angels from His throne and say, My servant has become loyal and obedient to Me.

amal_text.name: La-Howla
amal_text.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
amal_text.bangla_translation: Without the help of Allah, there is no way to escape from sin, and His servant has no power without His help.

items.title: Prayer for protection from all kinds of heavenly and earthly calamities
items.fazilat: A person who recites this dua three times in the morning and afternoon, no one and nothing can harm him in any way.

amal_text.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
amal_text.bangla_translation: I seek help in the Name of Allah, in Whose Name nothing in the heavens and the earth can do any harm. And He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing, All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

items.title: The reign of Chalatul Hajat
items.fazilat: If any kind of need or necessity arises, whether it is related to God or to people, first of all perform ablution in accordance with the Sunnah. Then, with a deep heart, two rak'ats of prayer will be recited together with ``Etminan''. Then some praises and praises to Allah will be given. Then recite Darad Sharif: Recite the following Dua at least once or as many times as you wish. At the end, he will present a petition to the great court for his special purpose.

amal_text.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِن كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِن كُلِّ إِثْمٍ لَا تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ وَلَا حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
amal_text.bangla_translation: There is no god but Allah, the Most Forbearing, the Most Merciful. Most Holy is Allah Ta'ala, the Owner of the Great Arash. And all good and noble qualities belong to Allah, the Owner and Sustainer of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for those things by which Your mercy is surely revealed. There is no way to escape from all sins and no power to do good deeds without the help of Allah.

items.title: Dua to be firm on Deen
items.fazilat: A person who keeps on making this dua, God willing, will be strong on his religion and will be blessed with death with faith.

amal_text.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
amal_text.bangla_translation: O changer of hearts, keep my heart firm on your religion.

items.title: Prayer for guidance of the heart and protection from the corruption of the soul
items.fazilat: Rasulullah ﷺ taught this prayer to Hazrat Hussain.

amal_text.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي رُشْدِي وَأَعِذْنِي مِن شَرِّ نَفْسِي
amal_text.bangla_translation: O Allah! Pour guidance into my heart and protect me from the corruption of my soul.

items.title: Prayer for protection from serious diseases
items.fazilat: In this terrible time when new and devastating diseases are emerging, this prayer should be recited very seriously.
items.reference: Abu Dawood Sharif, Jawaherul Bokhari 570 pages

amal_text.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَسَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
amal_text.bangla_translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, from insanity, from leprosy and from severe diseases.

items.title: The first act of death with faith — Dua after the five obligatory prayers
items.fazilat: In order to remain firm on faith and die with faith, recite this dua with great humility and sincerity after five obligatory prayers.

amal_text.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
amal_text.bangla_translation: O our Lord and Lord, you who have guided us, do not make our hearts crooked after this. And grant us a special mercy from You. Because surely you are a great giver and a selfless giver.

items.title: The second act of death with faith
items.fazilat: Within these two Ichim are the Ta'chir and Takt of Ichime-A'zam. It is an infallible counsel for firmness in faith and death with faith and for deliverance from all kinds of dangers and troubles.

amal_text.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
amal_text.bangla_translation: O Eternal One, O Mighty Sustainer, relying on Your mercy I seek Your help.

items.title: The third act of death with faith — the blessing of doing Meswak
items.fazilat: Kalemaye-Shahadat is remembered at the time of death by virtue of the blessing of time on the Sunnah of Meswak.

amal_text.name: Messwalk
amal_text.description: Using Messwalk regularly. The little finger of the right hand should be placed under the bottom of the meshwak and the thumb under its surface and the rest of the fingers should be placed on top of the meshwak.

items.title: 4th Act of Dying with Faith — Giving thanks for present faith
items.fazilat: Thanking Allah for the faith He has given us every day. Because the promise of Allah is that if you give thanks for the favors, He will definitely increase the favors. Therefore, if you give thanks for the current faith, it will definitely strengthen and improve the faith.

amal_text.name: Giving thanks for faith
amal_text.description: Thank Allah every day that He has given you faith.

items.title: 5th Act of Death with Faith — Protection from evil eye
items.fazilat: In exchange for protection from evil eye, there is a promise of Iman, i.e. the sweetness of Iman, in the confection. Once this happiness is bestowed in the heart, it can never be taken away. Therefore, the good news of death with faith is also inherent in this.

items.title: 6th Act of Death with Faith — Dua'e-Wasila after Adhan
items.fazilat: It is narrated in Bukhari Sharif that the Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, said: My intercession will become obligatory for the person who recites this supplication according to the rules.

amal_text.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَوةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَاماً مَحْمُوداً الَّذِي وَعَدتَّهُ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
amal_text.bangla_translation: O Allah, Lord of this complete call and constant prayer! Give strength and honor to Muhammad, and make him reach the position of Mahmud which You have promised him. Surely you don't hate Wada.

items.title: The 7th act of death with faith — companionship and love of God
items.fazilat: It is understood by several traditions of Bukhari and Muslim Sharif that for the sake of Allah, with the blessing of companionship of the people of God and love with the people of God, death with faith is the heavenly decision. Spending some time in the company of a saint is better than a hundred years of unrepentant and monotonous worship.

amal_text.name: To be with God's people
amal_text.description: Be in the company of good people with God regularly.

items.title: Prayer and Tariqah of Istekhara
items.fazilat: It is in the hadith: If you do something after consulting (advice), you will not face shame and regret, and if you ask Allah to know good and bad, you will not fail. Not knowing good and bad from one's Lord through Istekhara is nothing but one's own bad luck and misfortune.
items.method: After praying two rak'ahs of nafal, recite this dua with a lot of heart.

amal_text.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِن فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ إِن كُنتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيرٌ لِّي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَإِن كُنتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِّي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
amal_text.bangla_translation: O Allah, I seek goodness from You through Your knowledge, strength through Your might and from Your great bounty. You are powerful and I am powerless, you are wise and I am ignorant, you are wise of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this deed is good for my deen, livelihood and outcome, then make it easy and make it easy, then bless it. And if you know that this action is harmful to my deen, livelihood and outcome, then withdraw it from me and withdraw me from it. Determine for me wherever there is goodness, then make me content with it.

items.title: Acts of repentance prayer
items.fazilat: If any action or sin is committed against the Shariat, he will perform two rakat nafal prayers and repent to Allah Almighty with great supplication and be very ashamed and repentant and cry and cry for forgiveness. It is in the hadith, you cry. If you don't cry, try to make your face look like a cryer. If you do such a deed, that sin is forgiven by the infinite grace of the Most Merciful.

amal_text.name: Repentance prayer
amal_text.description: Pray two rakat nafal prayers and repent to Allah with tears.
